remarks: Open & airy apartment filled with natural light from large windows. The eat-in kitchen has quartz counters, tile backsplash and stainless steel appliances. Bedroom offers ample closet space. The bathroom was recently remodeled & features a full-sized, fully-tiled walk-in shower. Hardwood floors throughout. Heat, hot water and a reserved parking are included. Convenient to public transportion, shopping, hospital and highways. Access to Calf Pasture Beach.
